claim: Depth 2 is proved for K>=3 and all c>=0 by the parity-split half-level-K Bernstein method (self-check 140 trials, 0 mismatches, K up to 300 and c up to 20; certificates regenerated after the ERR-0010 fix). Depths 3+ are RETRACTED pending re-derivation -- see each run's retraction note and docs/ERRATA.md ERR-0010/ERR-0011.

runs.retraction: RETRACTED 2026-08-18 (ERR-0010/ERR-0011). This depth's earlier 'proved' record came from a build_branch with a wrong denominator-clearing (prefix product + Qg^(d-j) instead of complement product + Qg^j), and from a self-check whose range (K<=15, c<0.3) was far narrower than the Bernstein box it was meant to validate. Additionally the half-level trick itself is now known to be INAPPLICABLE for c beyond roughly 0.43 at odd depth: it forces the shore-bounding integer to equal N/2, while the true minimiser of T_k grows like sqrt(3)*lam, so T_K sits far above the true shore and the knife is legitimately negative in that gap. Physics is NOT violated -- verified at n=101, lam=100: knife is -1 at D=T_K=2500.9 but +1 at the true shore T_hat=1890.4 and below. Re-derivation with an UNGLUED shore parameter is in progress.
